name: support-ticket-system
description: Run backend + frontend with one command

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:push && npm --prefix backend run prisma:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
